answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before joining the market, like a marble dropped into a common jar: the stake returns only after a history of honest trades, and any fraud slashes it. A sybil operator facing a rising tide of fake identities must fund every copy, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents keep one cheap deposit. The old fable that identity is free dies once every account carries real, losable collateral.
